name: workspace
description: Workspace for reflex: per-screen knowledge (screens/), flow plans (plans/) and run reports. The tool lives in ../reflex.

account._note: Put your own test account in workspace/.env (gitignored): REFLEX_TEST_PHONE / REFLEX_TEST_PASSWORD / REFLEX_TEST_PIN. Never commit an account here.

report._note: Set REPORT_UPLOAD_URL in .env (or report.uploadUrl here) to enable `uploadReport`; report.brand { logoUrl, eyebrow, footer } customises the HTML report header and footer.

apps._note: App targets: a plan's `app: <key>` resolves to apps.<key>.<platform> (package/activity or bundleId). Add one with `reflex app init`.
